About HotPlot

HotPlot is an interactive wildfire mapping and forecasting tool that helps users monitor and prepare for fire risks.

Key features include:

  • Real-time wildfire detection from satellite data
  • Fire danger forecasts for your location
  • Information about nearby fires
  • Multiple data layers to visualize fire activity

Search for your location to get started and view fire forecasts.
